title: Dispatch, rebooted
dek: This site now runs a git-backed publishing pipeline. Here's the shape of it.
body:
LEAD: New coat of paint, same philosophy — no backend, no database, nothing between you and the content but a static file.

This site is a single HTML file plus a small publish layer. When I write a post, the editor commits it as JSON straight to the GitHub repo; GitHub Pages redeploys; you see it. The whole pipeline is auditable in the repo — there is no server to trust.

## What's coming

Notes from the GSoC '26 OpenVINO work, C++ systems things I learn the hard way, and the occasional tool worth sharing. Short, concrete, written when there's something to say.

> If a post is here, it earned the commit.
